decisions.finding: The interior yod dot is fully detached, below the head and left of its descending tail. It is bounded by clear white separation. Same-page Daniel10a yod supplies a separate detached positive control; plain yod in יהי10 has no low-left branch.

The long vav shaft broadens directly into a heavy horizontal lower mass, followed by a short lower-right bulb. Both zoom4 full-glyph and zoom6 lower-glyph captures preserve the join. The connected stamp is not cleanly separable into an exact patah or qamats configuration. Retain the note rather than infer a vowel from the existing word or neighboring resolved prefixes.
